summary: Keep Scout password auth. Add self-serve Forgot Password + admin Reset Password, both emailing a 7-day relative signed reset link. New reset controller allows verified users; onboarding one-shot guard stays.

split_option.A: Backend: ScoutResetPasswordController + notification + routes + admin ScoutUsersResource action + tests
split_option.B: Self-serve: ClarityScoutAuthController forgot endpoint + Login.vue + auth.js + API tests

sizing.reason_keep_together: ACs require both self-serve and admin assist; shared notification/controller. Splitting leaves half the lockout path unshipped.

excluded_sites.reason: Force-login is admin impersonation, not recovery

human_approvals_required.reason: Scout auth signed reset — approved via gate Q2=B + sizing keep-together

subtasks.title: Signed reset backend (notification + controller + routes + blade)
subtasks.approach: Add ScoutPasswordResetNotification mirroring ScoutOnboardingNotification (7-day relative signed URL to scout.reset-password). Add ScoutResetPasswordController mirroring ScoutSetPasswordController but WITHOUT rejecting verified users; after successful reset, optionally revoke clarity-scout-token tokens. Reuse set-password blade or thin reset blade. Register GET/POST under ValidateScoutSignedUrl. Do not change ScoutSetPasswordController one-shot guard.
subtasks.intended_diffs: NEW notification+controller; web.php routes sibling to set-password; blade may accept title/copy prop or shared view

subtasks.title: Admin Reset Password action on ScoutUsersResource
subtasks.approach: Add Action sibling to resend_onboarding, visible when assigned user has email_verified_at set. Sends ScoutPasswordResetNotification. Analytics + activity_log like resend. Org-scoped via existing resource query; setPermissionsTeamId before permission checks.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New record Action password_reset; tests for visibility verified vs unverified

subtasks.title: Self-serve Forgot Password API + Login.vue
subtasks.approach: Add throttled POST /api/scout/forgot-password accepting email; if user exists with clarity-scout + kit, send ScoutPasswordResetNotification; always return generic success (no email enumeration). Login.vue: Forgot Password link toggles email-only form calling the endpoint. Update ClarityScoutAuthControllerTest.
subtasks.intended_diffs: forgotPassword method; route; UI link+form; auth.forgotPassword(); tests for throttle + generic response
subtasks.note: parallelizable with t2 only after t1; t2 and t3 have disjoint files
